method: Read-only code inspection of current public APIs, recipes and tests by four parallel reviewers; not a runtime reference comparison.

ratings.C: close: a public API covers the main behaviour so the outcome is achievable by a developer or end user

parityScope: Functional parity: every in-scope entry is C in Vanilla, Vue and Foldkit. Stretch entries (Pro outcomes, templates, long tail; wave 7) and intentional gaps are excluded from the parity denominator.
